# Pnevma

<!-- Generated by tools/theme-readme-gen.py from scheme.toml; do not edit. -->

Terminal-inspired colors for GNOME (GTK 3, GTK 4 and libadwaita, GNOME Shell) and for terminals and command-line tools. Variants: dark only.

![Pnevma dark palette](palette-dark.svg)

- Colors: Pnevma (colours of the Ptyxis built-in 'Pnevma'; origin named in the built-in's header: https://github.com/Gogh-Co/Gogh/tree/master/themes/Pnevma.yml).
- Default accent: cyan (#8ADBB4); the other accents are listed by `switch-theme`.
- Ptyxis uses its built-in palette `Pnevma`.

## Install and use

```
ujust gnome-candy install-theme pnevma
ujust gnome-candy switch-theme pnevma
```

Without the image recipe, run `just install-theme pnevma` and `just switch-theme pnevma` in a checkout of [candy-for-gnome](https://github.com/redcodeworks/candy-for-gnome).
